caseNameFull: McKinlay, Trustee in Bankruptcy v. Philadelphia National Bank
attorneys: Mr. Dean Hill Stanley for petitioner. Messrs. Bynum E. Hinton and Everett H. Brown, Jr., for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied. Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
